counterfactual_missing_items: renal biopsy confirmation of mesangial IgA deposits
family history or extrarenal features of Alport syndrome
response.rationale: R3 best explains recurrent painless glomerular hematuria with 70% dysmorphic red cells; R4 shares glomerular hematuria but lacks Alport's family/extrarenal features and is less common; R1/C1 only cite incidental sand-like stones and do not explain dysmorphic red cells.

rejected.why: Redundant append-only completion of R1 with same stone span; does not address glomerular hematuria.
Nephrolithiasis is supported only by incidental left kidney stones and fails to explain 70% dysmorphic red cells or recurrent painless hematuria.
